scripts.start:backend:aws: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$lines = aws configure export-credentials --profile default --format env-no-export; foreach ($line in $lines) { if ($line -match '^(AWS_[A-Z_]+)=(.*)$') { Set-Item -Path Env:$($matches[1]) -Value $matches[2] } }; python -m uvicorn backend.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8010 --reload"
scripts.start:backend:aws:profile: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$profile = if ($env:AWS_PROFILE -and $env:AWS_PROFILE.Trim()) { $env:AWS_PROFILE } else { 'default' }; $lines = aws configure export-credentials --profile $profile --format env-no-export; foreach ($line in $lines) { if ($line -match '^(AWS_[A-Z_]+)=(.*)$') { Set-Item -Path Env:$($matches[1]) -Value $matches[2] } }; python -m uvicorn backend.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8010 --reload"
scripts.start:full: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend"
scripts.start:full:aws: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend:aws"
scripts.start:full:aws:profile: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend:aws:profile"
